paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption_used: Training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B on the Easy and Hard training sets, displayed as two vertically stacked line plots. In the Easy Training Set (top panel), both Llama-On-Policy-Easy (teal) and Llama-LUFFY-Easy (red) start near 0.0 and increase over 500 steps, with LUFFY reaching approximately 0.4 and On-Policy reaching approximately 0.35 at step 500. In the Hard Training Set (bottom panel), Llama-LUFFY-Hard shows steady improvement from near 0.0 to approximately 0.2 by step 500, while Llama-On-Policy-Hard initially rises to approximately 0.05 before declining back toward 0.0 after step 150. Notably, the performance gap between the two methods is substantially wider on the Easy set, where LUFFY maintains a consistent lead of approximately 0.10 throughout training, compared to the Hard set where their trajectories only clearly diverge after step 200.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training rewards of two language models, Llama-On-Policy-Easy and Llama-LUFFY-Easy, along with Llama-On-Policy-Hard and Llama-LUFFY-Hard, across the Easy and Hard training sets. The x-axis, labeled “Steps,” is linear, ranging from 0 to 500 with tick intervals of 50, and represents the number of training steps. The y-axis, labeled “Training Rewards,” is linear and ranges from 0.0 to 0.4, with tick intervals of 0.05. The top panel shows the training rewards of Llama-On-Policy-Easy (teal) and Llama-LUFFY-Easy (red) on the Easy training set, with both lines starting near 0.0 and increasing to approximately 0.35 and 0.4 respectively by step 500. The bottom panel depicts the training rewards of Llama-On-Policy-Hard (black) and Llama-LUFFY-Hard (red) on the Hard training set, with the Llama-LUFFY-Hard line beginning at approximately 0.0 and peaking at roughly 0.2 by step 500, whilst the Llama-On-Policy-Hard line rises to approximately 0.05 and subsequently declines back to near 0.0 after step 150.
